summary: ADR-0057 accepted 2026-08-05; knowledge publication exclusively maintain-knowledge-base with separate append-only confirmed request; request binds caller, trigger, one existing target plan, pinned main commit, timestamp, nonautomatic status, authority, and hash-verified stale maintenance route; publish gate fails closed without bindings; Acceptance stale handling is typed, hash-bound, nonauthorizing, append-only; VDD/Acceptance reject outputs outside exact target directory; semantic catalog excludes authority manifests and knowledge contexts; standalone builder read-only, publication gate alone activates layers/pointers via validated capability; versioned top-level discovery selects highest numeric version and supports two requirements filenames; historical/read-only checks remain compatible, new publications record summary/hash; extends ADR-0044/0048/0050; resolves recursive freshness loop and prevents sibling-plan mutation
